prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Fort Lauderdale FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Real Property Management United** looks like a strong first company to interview. Its Fort Lauderdale office says it manages single-family homes and offers full-service management across Broward County, including owner reporting and maintenance coordination. [Website](https://www.unitedrpm.com/)

Also compare **Gibson Group Management**, which advertises tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance, and coverage for a simple uncontested eviction. [Website](https://www.gibsongroupmanagement.com/)

Before choosing, ask each for a written fee schedule and sample management agreement. Compare the leasing and ongoing-management fees, renewal and inspection charges, maintenance approval limits, cancellation terms, and how quickly they respond to owners and tenants. Ask for references from owners of similar single-family rentals—not just general reviews.
